# appgatesdp_stats_app_discovery (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `descending` (String) Whether the sorting is applied descending or ascending. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `order_by` (String) The field name to sort the result list. Supported fields vary from object to object. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `query` (String) Query string to filter the result list. It's used for various fields depending on the object type.  Send multiple query parameters to make the queries more specific.
- `range` (String) 'Range string to limit the result list. Format: -. 3-10 means he items between the (including) 3rd and the 10th
 will be returned. Defaults to all objects.'

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) The time the stats was generated. Deprecated as of 6.4
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `distinct_app_count` (Number) The number of total distinct Discovered Apps.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `name` (String) User-friendly name for the stats. Deprecated as of 6.4
- `refresh_interval` (Number) Recommended refresh interval in minutes. Deprecated as of 6.4

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `access_count` (Number) Number of unique users have attempted to access this app.
- `app` (String) The app name, with the domain field it makes up the discovered hostname.
- `distinguished_names` (Attributes List) A list of distinguished names that tried to access this app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--distinguished_names))
- `domain` (String) The domain name as configured.
- `ips` (List of String) The resolved IP addresses for this app.
